Thought: The final volume of the system at the end of the simulation is 6312.6547 cubic angstroms. To calculate the density, I need to convert this volume to cubic centimeters and use the mass of Magnesium. The atomic mass of Magnesium is approximately 24.305 g/mol, and there are 250 atoms in the simulation. I will calculate the density and provide the final answer.

1. Convert volume from cubic angstroms to cubic centimeters:
   \[
   1 \text{ cubic angstrom} = 10^{-24} \text{ cm}^3
   \]
   \[
   \text{Volume in cm}^3 = 6312.6547 \times 10^{-24} \text{ cm}^3
   \]

2. Calculate the mass of the system:
   \[
   \text{Mass} = \frac{250 \text{ atoms} \times 24.305 \text{ g/mol}}{6.022 \times 10^{23} \text{ atoms/mol}}
   \]

3. Calculate the density:
   \[
   \text{Density} = \frac{\text{Mass}}{\text{Volume in cm}^3}
   \]
